run_narrator_demo: run the lavila narrator demo to generate text descriptions from a video file
run_main: run the main function to extract frames and generate narrated text from video
encode_image_frames: encode video frames into image features using the VCLM timesformer model
generate_text_from_video: generate text descriptions from video image features using nucleus sampling
extract_video_frames: extract specific frame IDs and load frames from a video using decord
